test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of interest (R) = 3% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Simple Interest (SI) = (3000 × 3 × 4) / 100

⇒ Simple Interest (SI) = 36000 / 100

⇒ Simple Interest (SI) = 360

**The simple interest on ₹3000 at 3% per year for 4 years is ₹360.**
